passives.name: ShinraEquipmentPassive1
passives.description:
Every {1} seconds:
- This unit's next attack applies a $DemonHead for {2} seconds
Enemies inside $DemonHead's radius:
- Take {3}% increased damage from this unit
$DemonHead:
- When this unit attacks an enemy inside its radius, apply 1 instance of $EnhancedBurn
- $EnhancedBurn deals {4}% damage in {5} ticks over {6} seconds
- Stores all $EnhancedBurn damage dealt while active
